repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python to provide granular visibility into agentic workflows.
Tracks specific work steps including tool execution, file modifications, test results, and token consumption.
Provides financial transparency for development teams by calculating the exact cost per task.
Integrates with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to monitor efficiency and spend.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Uses a deterministic, non-AI calculation engine for core financial metrics like sentiment cycles and ladder tiers.
Leverages LLMs only for synthesizing data into actionable market narratives.
Designed for local execution, supporting private API keys for Claude/Codex to ensure data privacy.
Ideal for quantitative traders needing real-time visualization of liquidity flows and market-wide momentum.

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically architected for quantitative trading research.
bullets: Python-based framework designed to orchestrate multiple specialized agents for financial analysis.
Focuses on automating the research pipeline, from hypothesis generation to strategy validation.
Modular architecture allows for the integration of custom financial data sources and backtesting engines.
Enables complex trading research workflows that require cross-agent collaboration and iterative data refinement.
